description: Ultimate Spider-Man (2005), the PC version statically recompiled to run natively on Switch, with an overlay for graphics, controls and performance. Needs your own PC copy: USM.exe and its Data folder.

notes: Minus, or L+R+Plus, opens the overlay: graphics, controls (swap A/B), performance (FPS cap, clocks) and Save settings to SD.
720p handheld runs at 30 FPS at stock clocks; 1080p docked needs the overlay's overclock. A resolution change needs Save settings to SD and a restart.

inputs.label: Ultimate Spider-Man for PC: USM.exe and the Data folder from your install

files.note: The game's program, loaded by the port
The whole Data folder: movies, sound, packs and text

generated.note: Overlay settings, written by Save settings to SD

steps: Copy USM.exe and the whole Data folder from your PC install to switch/usm/.
Start usm_switch.nro with full memory: hold R while starting a game.
